subject: proj
title: (R)PROJ.------AF.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 391 (JR-13). PROJ (projection) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars), MT-INFO (multi-information) and TR (transformation). From COS-P: C-CONT (composite continuance). From MT-INFO: AF-POST (affinity postulation). From TR: TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From C-CONT: INFO-CON (information convergence). From AF-POST: INTL (intellectualism) and LG-EXT (logical extension). From TH-CONT: RE-ST (restructuralism).
